program.name: Two-Split 60 II
program.subject: Signature
program.blurb: Two-Split 60, one level harder: every day starts where the original's Level II did, with the newer moves in the mix.
program.about: A strength-leaning two-day rhythm: upper body, then lower body, each finished with abs. The straight sets and rests are the ones you know, with fewer exercises done more seriously. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III adds reps on top. This II is the same program one level up, with the newest moves in the mix, and its Level III adds a set where the day has room.
